notes: Factory default per SFF-8472 is 10G mode (RS low, CDR bypassed); host must change hardware/software for 25G operation. 25GbE requires FEC RS(528,514) per IEEE 802.3. Link distance in EEPROM: 70 m OM3 50/125-µm at 25GbE, 100 m OM4 50/125-µm at 25GbE. Recommended case temperature 0°C to 70°C; absolute max case/storage –40°C to 85°C. Table 12 extinction ratio min 3.0 listed with unit dBm in source (likely dB). Stressed receiver sensitivity –5.2 dBm OMA at 25.78125 Gbaud per conformance test; –7.5 dBm OMA stressed sensitivity at 10.3125 Gbaud; receive sensitivity (OMA) –11.1 dBm at 10G. Damage threshold +3.4 dBm continuous exposure without damage (operation not required at that level).
